hero: What people ask, and where the app answers it
lede: Every question below is one a real admin, someone on the production team, or an artist asks themselves while using ShowFlow. Pick your role, then open a question to see the answer and the screen that carries it.

empty.title: No question matches that.
empty.body: Try a shorter search, or clear the filters and browse by stage.

stuck.body: Ask the person one step closer to the decision. Artists reach their production team in the date's chat. Production team asks an admin. Admins reach their platform administrator.

support.body: No support address is configured yet, so the suspended-workspace screen cannot show one. It is a platform-level value, not a per-workspace setting, and once it is set it appears everywhere the app tells you to get in touch.

footnote: Answers reflect the admin, production team and artist journey work shipped in August 2026. Question inventory: 2026-08-09 user-type journey questions.
